title: Greet by name
prompt: Return "Hello, " followed by the name and an exclamation mark, so "Tim" gives "Hello, Tim!".
starter:
func solve(name: String) -> String:
	return name
hint: Pieces of text join together with +. Mind the space after the comma.
solution:
func solve(name: String) -> String:
	return "Hello, " + name + "!"
